simple.meaning: מַעֲצָד (maʻătsâd) is a Hebrew word meaning “an axe.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מַעֲצָד (H4621) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Isaiah 44:12, with occurrences in Isaiah, Jeremiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַעֲצָד (H4621) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מַעֲצָד (H4621) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מַעֲצָד (maʻătsâd) / H4621 is traced through Isaiah 44:12, Jeremiah 10:3 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
